svg.title: ザンジバル全域とウングジャ島の拡大図
svg.desc: タンザニア本土とウングジャ・ペンバ両島の実際の位置関係、および同じ海岸線を拡大したウングジャ島の別枠表示。
svg.metadata: Target land: GSHHG/GSHHS high-resolution shoreline via Basemap 2.0.0 (Paul Wessel and Walter H. F. Smith; https://www.soest.hawaii.edu/wessel/gshhg/), assigned with Natural Earth 1:10m Admin-0 map subunits ca96624a56bd078437bca8184e78163e5039ad19 (public domain) unit TZZ (Zanzibar); internal land boundaries follow Natural Earth. Surrounding land: the same GSHHG shoreline, drawn to the canvas edge. WGS84; local-equirectangular-fit-v1, 1200x760. Mainland Tanzania and Kenya are context only. Unguja inset: same geometry at uniform scale.
